hooks.name: Always Allow Python/Django Scripts
hooks.description: Automatically allow execution of Python scripts, Django management commands, pip installs, pytest, Celery, npm, Vite, and Docker commands without requiring manual approval each time.

action.command:
python -c "
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
tool = data.get('tool_name', '')
params = str(data.get('tool_input', ''))
# Always allow python, pip, manage.py, pytest, celery, vite, npm, docker scripts
allowed_patterns = ['python', 'pip', 'manage.py', 'pytest', 'celery', 'npm', 'vite', 'docker', 'node']
if any(p in params.lower() for p in allowed_patterns):
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'permissionDecision': 'allow', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'Python/build script — auto-allowed by project hook'}}))
sys.exit(0)
"
